dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001243\_19](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001243) Category 1 during the period Dec 18 2025-Dec 26 2025 in Cocos (Keeling) Islands. The center of the storm was located near latitude -11.9 longitude 91.4. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
